program_section.section_text:
Located in the heart of Bavaria, Germany, our Pro IFX Year program enrolls each player in our partner German language institute, for intensive German language lessons for the duration of the program. Participants are placed in classes according to their level of German, whether beginning, intermediate or advanced. The language course is an integral program aspect and is the main academic component of the IFX program, enabling students to become conversational and in some cases fluent in the German language. Read Less

The German language is still regarded as a leading language in the world when it comes to industry and commerce. The ability to read, write and speak German can be a huge asset in one’s future career.

German language classes include lessons covering grammar, pronunciation, conversation, and cultural subjects.

In addition to our language school option, IFX offers an undergraduate Bachelor’s degrees in International Management as well as a Master’s Degrees in Management through a top private Business School in Nürnberg, Germany.

All courses are taught in English as the universal business language. The school embraces an international mindset, with partner Universities throughout the globe and an international student body.
program_section.section_title: University in Germany for international students

program_description:
IFX participants are enrolled either into an intensive German language school to learn how to read, write and speak the German language or into our partner Business School/University. In the University program, students pursue either an undergraduate Bachelor’s Degree or Graduate Master’s Degree.

Students will be provided with accommodations during their participation of the program. Accommodations are shared apartments with other roommates from around the world. A full immersion into the German culture is one of the main goals of our program.

Our German International Soccer Academy enables competitive participants over the age of 18 the opportunity to play soccer for a German semi-professional/Amateur club for one full or one half season. Players are placed to train and compete with a real German club according to their level of play.

An initial evaluation period upon arrival in Germany determines club placement.

program_players.player_says: “I played for TSV Rain in the 4th league of Germany. My teammates are very experienced players who have previously played in professional leagues."

"I’ve developed a lot as a player here, and the level is very high. This year, we are currently first in the table and aiming for promotion to the Regionalliga, which is the 4th division here in Germany."

program_details.detail_text:
Desire and commitment to learning the German language or studying at the IFX partner University
High School graduate
At least 18 years old at the start of the program
Flexible and mature personality; desire to be challenged, ability to remain open-minded and tolerant of cultural differences
Ability to meet student visa requirements. Applicants are responsible for checking with responsible German consulate for their area
Sports: Currently competing at a competitive level of soccer
Ability and willingness to adapt to a new environment, new culture, and European style

Academic Year, Fall and Spring Semester students are given an orientation upon arrival in Germany. Participants are placed to live in a shared private flat usually shared with others and roommates. Ongoing program support is provided by an in country program representative, assisting the students with their integration and process of getting settled in their new environment. Public transportation throughout Germany is very accessible. Transportation costs are the student’s responsibility, including daily transportation to and from school, if necessary.

Students will need to obtain a student visa to study in Germany and are required to apply for a residence permit for the duration of their stay. While citizens of the United States are permitted to apply for the student visa after arrival in Germany, citizens of other countries may not enjoy this same benefit. Please check with your local German consulate for their requirements for your country of residence.

Round-trip airfare from a major international airport near your home (in the continental U.S.) including domestic and international flights
Airport transfers on arrival and departure
Accommodations in shared private flat
Enrollment in intensive German language institute or University Business School
Assistance with student visa application process
Student health and accident insurance
24-hour emergency assistance
Assistance with scheduling doctor's appointments and physical therapy sessions
Pre-departure orientations
In country support throughout program duration provided by IFX Germany Management
Ongoing support of the main program components including academic, housing, cultural integration and soccer program elements.
Placement with a competitive German Amateur soccer club; players will train within the club’s normal training activities which is normally 2-4 days per week.
Management of international soccer transfer; IFX can make no guarantee that a player obtains a roster position, enabling participation in official matches. Subject to players’ level and partner club’s desire to utilize IFX player in official matches. Approval of registration subject to FIFA, National Federation and Regional Federation transfer regulations.
Management of German player pass (subject to Federation approval)
Weekly soccer training according to schedule of club
Weekly supplemental IFX training (2-4 times per week except during breaks)
Participation in soccer club tournaments, league matches, training sessions, cup matches etc.
Soccer league fees & club gear (shoes not included).
Official IFX Hummel training kit
Access to use of training field for individual training
Access to weight room
Periodic visits to watch professional Bundesliga training sessions upon availability
Attendance of Bundesliga matches (1 per Half Season included)
Access to Sports Psychologist (Multiple workshops included)
Access to Massage Therapists (extra fees apply)
Sports nutrition workshop and planning
Optional highlight video and video analysis (extra fees apply)
Optional opportunities to obtain coaching experience and coaching certifications.
Day excursions (i.e. intensive training camp in Bamberg, day trip to Prague, Allianz Arena tour) Extra fees apply
Guidance and support during the application process and throughout the program


German program requires a flat security deposit of $1250 to cover possible damages. Additional fees related to occupancy in the German room include a $100 end of year cleaning fee, and $30/month cleaning/repairs charge and $10/month for internet.
